prompt:
Create a production game sprite atlas for Grave Accord, matching the supplied hand-painted gothic courtyard reference and aged wooden crate reference. References are style/material references only; preserve every existing source image unchanged. Asset type: stylized-concept, transparent raster environment atlas. This is an actual in-game cover surface pack, not a mockup, poster or UI.
Exactly SIX separate horizontal rectangular cover objects on a genuinely transparent background, arranged in a perfectly regular TWO COLUMNS by THREE ROWS grid. All objects fully inside their cells with generous transparent gutters. No text, numbers, labels, frames, scenery, floor patches, characters, particles, glow or floating ornaments.
Each object is seen from a mostly top-down orthographic camera, its long axis perfectly horizontal, no rotated/isometric diamonds. Its top face forms a strong solid rectangle about 3.2 times wider than high, with a modest front edge and very small attached shadow. Readable dark outline, restrained highlight along the upper edge, moss-green/charcoal/old-stone palette, warm desaturated brass details, hand-painted fine texture. These must resemble substantial cover in a painted gothic game, not flat generic boxes or glossy icons. Keep center strips simple enough to stretch horizontally; put distinctive caps at the two ends, avoid circles or central emblems that would visibly deform.
Cell order, left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
1. Gatehouse: low moss-covered ashlar stone barricade, iron end braces.
2. Triage Yard: long dark weathered medical supply chest, canvas straps, no written labels or symbols.
3. Ossuary Works: industrial iron storage block, rivets, dark timber side edges.
4. Sunken Chapel: long pale worn carved stone altar with sparse chipped stone relief.
5. Bell Foundry: low dark cast-iron furnace workbench, muted brass vents and end plates, no fire.
6. Crown Crypt: long dark stone sarcophagus with aged bronze corner caps and a restrained stone lid.
Keep the same camera, lighting, outline weight, size and rectangular footprint for all six. Render at a large resolution with crisp alpha edges; transparency must be real, no checkerboard.
scope: New arena cover surface atlas. Original sources are preserved.
